Reach an evacuation-related building before the tsunami risk front reaches you. Official shelters are marked separately from non-official humanitarian high-rise candidates. Green ground frames appear after the tsunami starts to help identify evacuation-related building areas. Non-official candidates are not official shelters and are not safe or approved by default. Routes are estimated prototype guidance, not official evacuation routes. Crowd congestion, entrance blockage, safe-floor proxy status, weather, stamina, and collapse/debris exposure-event proxies can affect the result.
Non-official humanitarian vertical evacuation candidate. Not an official evacuation shelter. Use only when official shelter access is unsafe or unavailable.
